observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down traditional Albanian dance steps step-by-step with clear verbal guidance and demonstration. She encourages learners with a friendly and supportive tone throughout the tutorial.

lesson_structure.note: Greets the viewer and introduces the Pogonishte valle tutorial
Breaks down footwork: left foot leads and crosses over right
Adds hip movements for women, shifting weight right to left
Adds leg kicks to make the dance a bit fancy
Demonstrates the dance sequence with music practice

steps_taught.name: Pogonishte basic step
steps_taught.description: Left foot leads crossing right, followed by alternating steps

steps_taught.name: Pogonishte with kicks
steps_taught.description: Basic footwork layered with leg kicks

what_works: Clear breakdown of footwork before adding styling or kicks
what_hinders: Camera angle switches between front and back views without much warning

quotes.text: This is for the ladies only.
Now we're going to add some kicks.
If you are left alone on the dance floor...

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor demonstrates footwork starting with left foot crossing right in front
Demonstrates hip movement shifting from right to left
Adds kicks to the footwork sequence while moving

extraction.distinctive_method: Combining traditional folk footwork with upper body hip movements and optional performance flourishes like leg kicks tailored for solo dancing.
